environment.description: Celery worker on identical ECS Fargate infrastructure. LaunchDarkly project 'doc-platform-prod' has flag 'use-safe-path-resolution' with targeting rule: context.tenant matches '*' → serve variation index 1 (True). The flag's fallthrough is variation index 1 (True). Off variation is also index 1 (True). Flag prerequisites: none. The flag was last toggled 2024-11-03 and has 'require-comment-for-changes' approval gate in the LaunchDarkly environment approval settings. Note: the flag default value in code (the third argument to client.variation()) is False, which would apply only if the SDK fails to initialize or loses connectivity to LaunchDarkly relay proxy.
